subject: Activation demo request — CartStream checkout insights
messages:
From: Jamie Norton <jamie@cartstream.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Activation demo request — CartStream checkout insights

Hi Irene,

We just completed a quick self-serve test on Redwood and would like to see a short, focused demo to evaluate fit for a checkout personalization POC. High-level: we run CartStream (checkout flows for SMB retailers) — primary goals are: reduce checkout latency, A/B copy personalization per product category, and lower inference cost during peak traffic.

A few quick details:
- Traffic: ~250k sessions / month, peaks around 2.5k concurrent checkout requests on flash days
- Primary integration: server-side API calls to populate checkout copy + session-level embeddings
- Pilot timeline: hoping to kick a pilot in 4–6 weeks if things look good

Would appreciate a 30-minute demo that focuses on latency, batching/caching behavior, and an integration checklist. I can make time next week in the mornings (PT).

Thanks — Jamie
Jamie Norton
Head of Product, CartStream
jamie@cartstream.com

Attachment: cartstream-heatmap-aug.csv (sample hourly checkout volume heatmap)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Norton <jamie@cartstream.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation demo request — CartStream checkout insights

Hi Jamie — thanks for reaching out and sharing the heatmap. Happy to run a concise, engineering-focused demo. A couple of quick qualification questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Use case specifics: is the copy personalization deterministic (template + slots) or do you expect generative variations per user?
2) Volume shape: the CSV is helpful — can you confirm peak RPS for inference (not just page loads)?
3) Integration: will this be a server-side call from your checkout backend, or embedded in an edge layer?
4) Success metric for pilot: latency p95 < X ms? Cost per 1k imputes?

Preferred demo length: 30 minutes (overview + focused Q/A) or 60 minutes (deep dive + integration checklist).

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Aug 18, 9:00–9:30 AM PT
- Thu Aug 20, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu Aug 20, 11:00–11:45 AM PT (longer slot)

Irene will lead the demo; Marissa will cover onboarding and sandbox access. If you can reply with answers to the bullets and which slot works, I’ll lock it in and send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Jamie Norton <jamie@cartstream.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation demo request — CartStream checkout insights

Ben — great, answers below: 

1) Personalization: hybrid approach — primarily template-driven with conditional copy blocks; small percentage (~10%) of generative variants for promotional campaigns.
2) Peak inference RPS: roughly 250–300 RPS at peak checkout flow (we pre-aggregate most views client-side, but server-side copy rendering is critical).
3) Integration: server-side calls from our Java backend (Kotlin microservice) that sits behind a caching layer.
4) Pilot success metrics: p95 latency < 200ms for inference calls and stable cost projection under 30% of current spend.

Slot preference: Thu Aug 20, 11:00–11:45 AM PT preferred. Also adding Aarti (engineering lead) to the meeting after we confirm.

Thanks — looking forward
Jamie
